supersedes.reason: V1/V2 treated the back/spine contact as the rear edge of the backrest instead of its front face, and allowed the seat rim beneath the lower-leg silhouette.

shinEvidenceSource.rule: minimum non-transparent lower-leg silhouette across the declared shin evidence band

rules: The front face of the backrest must equal the seated visible back/spine contact plane; the body may not penetrate behind that face.
The front rim of the seat must remain behind the rear shin plane with at least 0.5 logical pixels of visible clearance.
The seat top remains exactly 11 logical pixels above the floor.
scope: Review and furniture-authoring evidence only. Keeper frames, route timing, root motion, Final, runtime and production art are unchanged.
